tier_note: Defensive tier reflects the opponent's season rank in that category through the data horizon, not their rank on game day. Each stat's tier is computed independently — a defense ranked Top 5 against the pass may not be Top 5 against the run, so the games counted (n) in the same tier column can genuinely differ row to row. This is not an error. DEFENSE-side blocks (team_allowed, def) use the OPPONENT OFFENSE's season rank in the matching category (rank 1 = best offense): 'top' = strongest offenses faced, 'bot' = weakest.
